root_motivation: Who: the agent asking which upstream providers it can connect, with which scope names; Joe adding a provider; the builder of every later connection PRD. What: one providers.toml describes a provider and every surface derives from it. Why not today: vault.rs hardcoded three presets, llms.txt repeated the names by hand and no surface said which scopes a provider accepts or whether the host had credentials for it.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.connect.providers and picks a provider that is available before promising its user anything; Operator Joe who adds a [name] block to providers.toml plus two env vars and deploys.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given providers.toml with testprov added, When the crate builds and the five surfaces are read, Then host.connect.providers, the provider enum, docs/connections.md, www/llms.txt and the callback route table all contain testprov with no edit outside providers.toml.
Given a hand edit that adds fakeprov to any one of the five surfaces, When the drift test runs, Then it fails naming the surface and the extra name.

Given MCPHOST_CONNECT_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID set and the secret unset, When host.connect.providers runs, Then github has available false, reason client_secret_not_configured and the response contains neither env value.
Given Provider::GOOGLE, When validate_scopes is given a valid spreadsheets.readonly URL and bogus, Then it returns Err([bogus]).
Given host.vault.provider_set with preset zzz, When it runs, Then the error is invalid_params and its message lists every name in Provider::ALL.
Given an anonymous host.quickstart, When it runs, Then connections.providers_available and providers_unavailable are present and partition Provider::ALL.
Given a providers.toml row missing token_url, When the crate builds, Then build.rs fails naming the provider and the field.
Given prod after this lands, When llms.txt is fetched, Then the Upstream connections section names host.connect.providers and every provider in the table (Live; deferred, operator-provisioned).
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: live curl of prod llms.txt after deploy.

scope: providers.toml (single source) + build.rs/src/connect/codegen.rs generate connect::Provider, ALL, parse and the SPECS table.
src/connect/mod.rs: availability from env (AppState.connect_providers), validate_scopes, renderers for docs/connections.md, the llms.txt section, the provider enum and the callback route table.
host.connect.providers tool, host.quickstart connections block, host.vault.provider_set presets via Provider::parse (preset_urls deleted).
non_goals: The connect flow itself (PRD 2); per-tenant BYOO providers; real provider registrations; R8 /connections.json (P2, no AC).

additional.testprov: AC1 appends the testprov row to a copy of providers.toml in the test; the committed table never lists it, so prod's list cannot show it.

five_whys_trace.q: Why could a provider be named on one surface and missing on another?
five_whys_trace.a: Each surface kept its own hand-written list (vault.rs presets, llms.txt prose).
No table existed that carried a provider's urls, scopes and credentials together.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does a generated table fix it?
five_whys_trace.a: Every surface reads one table and a drift test fails any surface whose set differs.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Where does testprov live (cfg test-support vs providers.toml)?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Test-only: AC1 appends it to the toml text and drives the same generator and renderers; the committed table has no testprov.
